subject: Wrong effort table for stations with 2 independent cameras

messages.author: 4b85f40a0f87fa84
messages.subject: Wrong effort table for stations with 2 independent cameras
parts:
Hey Jürgen,
I am analyzing data from a study with 27 camera-trap stations, each of which has 2 independent cameras. cameraOperation() correctly produces the camera operation table, indicating whether 0, 1 or 2 cameras were functional (and NA before setup/after retrieval).
But when I use this operation matrix in the detectionHistory() function, it returns an effort matrix that consists mostly of NAs and only a couple of occasions with actual effort, even though most occasions in this data set have some effort. The observation matrix also mostly consists of NAs. I tried specifying the minimum number of days as 1, and not specifying it at all, but I get the same erroneous effort matrix in both cases.
When I specify camerasIndependent=FALSE in the cameraOperation() function and use the resulting operation matrix (with values NA,0 or 1) in the detectionHistory() function, the effort and detection matrices look correct (only a few NAs). That's why I think the independent cameras are messing something up. Any idea what could be going on?
Thanks
Rahel
